# Obsidian Second Brain Skill

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor: Turn an Obsidian vault into a living, self-rewriting second brain: sources rewrite existing pages, contradictions reconcile automatically, and scheduled agents maintain the vault while you sleep. The vault core is 100 percent local and free, in plain markdown. X search via Grok needs a paid key.

The skill runs dozens of commands for saving notes, daily entries, kanban boards, people notes, decisions, deals and dev logs, with every write propagated to the places it belongs, never left as an orphaned note. Its research toolkit covers 7 commands, /x-read, /x-pulse, /research, /research-deep, /notebooklm, /youtube and /podcast, with findings saved to the vault automatically. Perplexity is optional, with a free key-less fallback, and YouTube works without a key. It also runs Crew, one shared logbook so several agents know what each other did, offers a SessionStart hook that loads the vault manual, and can bootstrap a new vault with presets for executive, builder, creator or researcher use. The SKILL.md is large, 91,239 bytes and 1,402 lines, so expect a long read. By @eugeniughelbur, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. X search via Grok needs a paid xAI key, for /x-read and /x-pulse only.
